templateName: Omega DOCX Template - Feasibility Study Standards
description: Complete formatting template for generating professional Omega documents using docx library. Based on Omega Feasibility Study Formatting Standards v1.0. Optimized for executive business documents (not academic). v1.1.0 adds table captions, figure captions, repeating headers, and Word style integration.

colors.description: Omega brand colors - use WITHOUT # prefix for docx library

paragraphSpacing.description: Standard spacing after paragraphs in twips

textNormalization.description: Unicode character replacements for text normalization

header.example: MRCC Proposal - Beni Suef BOT Advisory | CONFIDENTIAL

footer.example: Investment Decision Support Package | Page 5 of 24

createParagraph.description: Create styled paragraph with Omega defaults

createHeading.description: Create heading linked to MS Word styles for easy global editing. Consultants can modify all headings of same level by right-clicking and selecting 'Modify Style'.
createHeading.wordStyleIntegration: Uses HeadingLevel.HEADING_1/2/3 to link to Word's built-in styles
createHeading.documentStyles: Define custom Omega styles in Document.styles.paragraphStyles

createTable.description: Create table with Omega Professional style, including optional caption and repeating headers
features: Dark Teal header background with white text
Alternating row shading (odd rows get LIGHT_BG)
Repeating headers on multi-page tables (tableHeader: true)
Returns array [caption, table] for flexible placement
createTable.usageNote: IMPORTANT: Use spread operator when adding to sections array: ...createTable(headers, rows, caption)

createBullets.description: Create bullet list with Omega formatting

createKeyInsightBox.description: Create key insight box with minimalist left accent bar
createKeyInsightBox.returns: Array of 3 Paragraph objects (label, title, content)

bestPractices.textNormalization: Always apply fixText() to user-provided content to handle em-dashes, smart quotes, and special characters
bestPractices.justification: Body text should be justified for professional narrative flow
bestPractices.tableAlternation: Use alternating row shading (odd rows = LIGHT_BG) for readability
bestPractices.references: Always include source citations after tables and figures
bestPractices.keyInsights: Use sparingly to highlight critical findings for executives (2-3 per chapter maximum)
bestPractices.headingHierarchy: Maintain consistent hierarchy: H1 for chapters, H2 for sections, H3 for subsections
bestPractices.colorConsistency: Use exact Omega colors - no variations

dataPresentation.avoid: Long narrative descriptions of tabular data

exampleUsage.saveDocument:
const buffer = await Packer.toBuffer(doc);
fs.writeFileSync(outputPath, buffer);

beforeGeneration: All helper functions (fixText, createParagraph, createHeading, createTable, etc.) are defined
COLORS and SIZES constants match Omega standards
Text content passes through fixText() function
afterGeneration: Open document and verify heading hierarchy
Check table formatting (Dark Teal headers, alternating rows)
Verify justified text alignment in body paragraphs
Check Key Insight boxes have left accent bar
Verify source citations are blue and italic

versionHistory.changes: Initial template created from Omega Feasibility Study Standards v1.0
versionHistory.project: Beni Suef Dry Port BOT Tender Advisory

relatedFiles.standardsDocument: Omega Feasibility Study Formatting Standards v1.0 (JSON schema)

notes: This is an EXECUTIVE BUSINESS document template, not academic
All measurements in docx library use twips (1/20th of a point)
Colors in docx library use hex WITHOUT # prefix
Always test generated documents by opening in Microsoft Word
Justified alignment improves professional appearance of narrative text
Key Insight boxes should highlight 2-3 critical findings per chapter maximum
Table first column left-aligned, others centered for readability
Always include source citations for data tables and figures
